extraction.notes: AIR reports NAREIT FFO and Pro Forma FFO (the adjusted metric) with no AFFO subtotal, so affo fields are null. Pro Forma FFO does not deduct recurring capex; Capital Replacements of $5,552K for the quarter (Supplemental Schedule 9, consolidated, not NCI-adjusted) is recorded as the disclosed recurring capex. Shares 157,088K reproduce reported per-share figures: 65,584/157,088 = $0.42; 89,509/157,088 = $0.57; 375,881/157,088 = $2.39. 'Incremental cash received from leased properties' is categorized as 'other' since it is a cash-vs-GAAP lease income adjustment without a closer category. 'Separation and transition related costs' mapped to severance_restructuring. Income tax adjustment line is printed as an em dash (zero) in 2022 and included at 0.
